Samples were pre-digested with 1.6 μg of Lys-C (Pierce) and incubated at 37 °C for 2 h under agitation and digested with bead-immobilized trypsin (40 μL of beads per 250 μg of protein; Pierce) for 16 h at 37 °C under agitation.
tissue sections were resuspended in the cytosolic (“C”) buffer of the CNMCS compartmental protein extraction kit (Millipore) and disrupted by vortexing.
The mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent mode.
The full MS scan was followed by MS/MS for the top 10 precursor ions in each cycle with a normal collision energy of 28 and dynamic exclusion of 30 s.
Disulfide bonds were reduced by adding 5 mM dithiothreitol to the samples for a 1 h incubation under agitation at room temperature.
Free cysteines were alkylated by adding iodoacetamide at a final concentration of 8.3 mM to the samples for a 1 h incubation under agitation at room temperature in the dark.
